question: What was Apple's net income in its latest filing?
sql: SELECT c.name, f.period_end, f.value AS net_income FROM fact_financials f JOIN dim_company c ON f.cik = c.cik WHERE c.name ILIKE '%apple inc%' AND f.metric = 'NetIncomeLoss' ORDER BY f.period_end DESC LIMIT 1

question: What are Microsoft's total assets?
sql: SELECT c.name, f.period_end, f.value AS total_assets FROM fact_financials f JOIN dim_company c ON f.cik = c.cik WHERE c.name ILIKE '%microsoft%' AND f.metric = 'Assets' ORDER BY f.period_end DESC LIMIT 1

question: What was NVIDIA's operating income?
sql: SELECT c.name, f.period_end, f.value AS operating_income FROM fact_financials f JOIN dim_company c ON f.cik = c.cik WHERE c.name ILIKE '%nvidia%' AND f.metric = 'OperatingIncomeLoss' ORDER BY f.period_end DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which 10 companies had the highest revenue?
sql: SELECT c.name, f.period_end, f.value AS revenue FROM fact_financials f JOIN dim_company c ON f.cik = c.cik WHERE f.metric = 'Revenues' ORDER BY f.value DESC LIMIT 10

question: Which 10 companies had the biggest net loss?
sql: SELECT c.name, f.period_end, f.value AS net_income FROM fact_financials f JOIN dim_company c ON f.cik = c.cik WHERE f.metric = 'NetIncomeLoss' AND f.value < 0 ORDER BY f.value ASC LIMIT 10

question: What are the 10 largest companies by total assets?
sql: SELECT c.name, f.period_end, f.value AS total_assets FROM fact_financials f JOIN dim_company c ON f.cik = c.cik WHERE f.metric = 'Assets' ORDER BY f.value DESC LIMIT 10

question: How many companies are in each sector?
sql: SELECT sector, COUNT(*) AS companies FROM dim_company GROUP BY sector ORDER BY companies DESC

question: Which 5 manufacturing companies hold the most cash?
sql: SELECT c.name, f.period_end, f.value AS cash FROM fact_financials f JOIN dim_company c ON f.cik = c.cik WHERE c.sector = 'Manufacturing' AND f.metric = 'CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue' ORDER BY f.value DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which companies have more liabilities than assets?
sql: SELECT c.name, f.period_end, MAX(f.value) FILTER (WHERE f.metric = 'Assets') AS assets, MAX(f.value) FILTER (WHERE f.metric = 'Liabilities') AS liabilities FROM fact_financials f JOIN dim_company c ON f.cik = c.cik GROUP BY c.name, f.period_end HAVING liabilities > assets ORDER BY liabilities - assets DESC

question: What is Kroger's liabilities-to-assets ratio?
sql: SELECT c.name, f.period_end, MAX(f.value) FILTER (WHERE f.metric = 'Liabilities') / MAX(f.value) FILTER (WHERE f.metric = 'Assets') AS liabilities_to_assets FROM fact_financials f JOIN dim_company c ON f.cik = c.cik WHERE c.name ILIKE '%kroger%' GROUP BY c.name, f.period_end ORDER BY f.period_end DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is Cisco's equity (assets minus liabilities)?
sql: SELECT c.name, f.period_end, MAX(f.value) FILTER (WHERE f.metric = 'Assets') - MAX(f.value) FILTER (WHERE f.metric = 'Liabilities') AS equity FROM fact_financials f JOIN dim_company c ON f.cik = c.cik WHERE c.name ILIKE '%cisco%' GROUP BY c.name, f.period_end ORDER BY f.period_end DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which companies with over $1 billion revenue have the highest net profit margin?
sql: SELECT c.name, f.period_end, MAX(f.value) FILTER (WHERE f.metric = 'NetIncomeLoss') / MAX(f.value) FILTER (WHERE f.metric = 'Revenues') AS net_margin FROM fact_financials f JOIN dim_company c ON f.cik = c.cik GROUP BY c.name, f.period_end HAVING MAX(f.value) FILTER (WHERE f.metric = 'Revenues') > 1e9 AND net_margin IS NOT NULL ORDER BY net_margin DESC LIMIT 10

question: What is NVIDIA's operating margin?
sql: SELECT c.name, f.period_end, MAX(f.value) FILTER (WHERE f.metric = 'OperatingIncomeLoss') / MAX(f.value) FILTER (WHERE f.metric = 'Revenues') AS operating_margin FROM fact_financials f JOIN dim_company c ON f.cik = c.cik WHERE c.name ILIKE '%nvidia%' GROUP BY c.name, f.period_end ORDER BY f.period_end DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the average net income by sector?
sql: SELECT c.sector, AVG(f.value) AS avg_net_income, COUNT(*) AS companies FROM fact_financials f JOIN dim_company c ON f.cik = c.cik WHERE f.metric = 'NetIncomeLoss' GROUP BY c.sector ORDER BY avg_net_income DESC

question: How many companies reported a net loss?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cik) AS companies_with_loss FROM fact_financials WHERE metric = 'NetIncomeLoss' AND value < 0

question: How many companies are there per country?
sql: SELECT COALESCE(country, 'Unknown') AS country, COUNT(*) AS companies FROM dim_company GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY companies DESC LIMIT 10

question: What are the total assets of all finance companies combined?
sql: SELECT SUM(f.value) AS total_assets FROM fact_financials f JOIN dim_company c ON f.cik = c.cik WHERE c.sector = 'Finance, Insurance & Real Estate' AND f.metric = 'Assets' AND f.period_end = '2025-09-30'

question: Compare the net income of Apple, Microsoft and NVIDIA.
sql: SELECT c.name, f.period_end, f.value AS net_income FROM fact_financials f JOIN dim_company c ON f.cik = c.cik WHERE f.metric = 'NetIncomeLoss' AND (c.name ILIKE '%apple inc%' OR c.name ILIKE '%microsoft%' OR c.name ILIKE '%nvidia%') ORDER BY f.value DESC

question: Which reporting dates are available?
sql: SELECT period_end, quarter, year FROM dim_date ORDER BY period_end

question: Show all financial metrics for Walmart.
sql: SELECT c.name, f.period_end, f.metric, f.value FROM fact_financials f JOIN dim_company c ON f.cik = c.cik WHERE c.name ILIKE '%walmart%' ORDER BY f.period_end DESC, f.metric

question: Which companies have more than $10 billion in cash?
sql: SELECT c.name, f.period_end, f.value AS cash FROM fact_financials f JOIN dim_company c ON f.cik = c.cik WHERE f.metric = 'CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue' AND f.value > 10e9 ORDER BY f.value DESC

question: Which companies had the highest revenue in calendar Q3 2025?
sql: SELECT c.name, f.period_end, f.value AS revenue FROM fact_financials f JOIN dim_company c ON f.cik = c.cik JOIN dim_date d ON f.period_end = d.period_end WHERE f.metric = 'Revenues' AND d.year = 2025 AND d.quarter = 3 ORDER BY f.value DESC LIMIT 10

question: Which non-US companies have the largest total assets?
sql: SELECT c.name, c.country, f.value AS total_assets FROM fact_financials f JOIN dim_company c ON f.cik = c.cik WHERE f.metric = 'Assets' AND c.country <> 'US' ORDER BY f.value DESC LIMIT 10

question: Which sector has the highest total revenue?
sql: SELECT c.sector, SUM(f.value) AS total_revenue FROM fact_financials f JOIN dim_company c ON f.cik = c.cik WHERE f.metric = 'Revenues' GROUP BY c.sector ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which 5 retail companies made the most profit?
sql: SELECT c.name, f.period_end, f.value AS net_income FROM fact_financials f JOIN dim_company c ON f.cik = c.cik WHERE c.sector = 'Retail Trade' AND f.metric = 'NetIncomeLoss' ORDER BY f.value DESC LIMIT 5
